Covers: audience building, waitlist strategy, beta testing, launch timing, Product Hunt preparation, Reddit/HackerNews seeding, KOL outreach, and post-launch momentum. Real case studies from Manus, Devin, AFFiNE (30x PH #1 winner).

产品发布前完整指南 — 从发布前4周到Day 1的完整检查清单和攻略。涵盖：用户预热、等流策略、beta测试、发布时间选择、Product Hunt准备、Reddit/HN预热、KOL外联、发布后热度延续。真实案例：AFFiNE 30次日榜第一。

Website: https://www.gingiris.com

Keywords: pre-launch, product launch, launch strategy, launch preparation, startup launch, go-to-market, product release, launch day, launch checklist, product hunt, github stars, viral launch, 冷启动, 产品发布, 发布攻略
